summary: Imported the schema-based AOT cache validation from candidate PR 509, then completed the contract identified by review PR 547: schema_version now requires the exact int type, so True is rejected, and JitCacheManager.set() mutates its memory cache only after a successful validated disk write. The candidate regressions and new failing-before/passing-after boundary regressions pass.
